# Facets sample vault

This small vault contains ordinary Markdown notes and a sparse K-Plex configuration. It includes no executable plugin or remote loader. Use the matching reviewed K-Plex build in a disposable vault; opening these examples is not an installation or permission to deploy to a personal vault.

1. Open Start here and K-Plex.
2. Select Views and lenses, then Canvas view: Facets.
3. Choose Wu Xing, ACE, PARA, GTD, eACCESS or the custom State preset.
4. Follow Metal perspective and compare the five relative Wu Xing explanations.
5. Select a category through the note action or drop a note into a category; review the native preview before assigning. Undo is guarded against later edits.

The seven example notes cover every category of the five templates and custom State. Unassigned and Conflicting examples stay reachable. Normal note-to-note connectors come from children metadata and existing links. Solid generating and dashed regulating guides are decorative model explanations.

The built-in ACE labels Add/Connect/Express and seven-category eACCESS are K-Plex adaptations from the maintainer specification. Presets are editable examples, not official workflow engines. See docs/FACETS.md in the source repository for details and attribution.

To use this as a separate sample vault, install the matching plugin by its normal process; binaries are intentionally absent. Do not copy these settings over an existing vault. For repository validation the authorized disposable Small environment receives test-owned copies under a unique folder and is restored afterward.
